clue.text: Here inside and elsewhere it's really heavenly!

indicators.note: inside tells us the word before it is set within the phrase that follows it

parts.note: et al. is the Latin abbreviation for et alibi, meaning and elsewhere
taken as written

explanation.surface: An exclamation that the place you are in, and everywhere else too, is truly divine.
explanation.walkthrough: 'it's really' is link padding. 'and elsewhere' is the Latin et alibi, a sense solvers rarely recall, and 'inside' signals the container.
explanation.definitionFit: Ethereal describes something delicate and otherworldly, as if belonging to the heavens or the celestial sphere.

clue.text: Choose one in a couple of hundred for language

indicators.note: in tells us the choosing word plus the numeral go inside the two hundreds

parts.note: C is the Roman numeral for a hundred, so two of them give CC
to choose is to opt
I is the Roman numeral for one

explanation.surface: An instruction to pick one item from roughly two hundred, in order to learn a language.
explanation.definitionFit: Coptic is the liturgical tongue of the Egyptian Christian church, descended from ancient Egyptian.

clue.text: He denounces dealer holding copper back

indicators.note: holding means the dealer word wraps around the other piece

parts.note: a dealer is a trader

indicators.note: back says the chemical symbol is to be read in reverse

parts.note: Cu is the chemical symbol for copper

explanation.surface: A man condemns a merchant who is withholding money owed to him.
explanation.walkthrough: 'He denounces' is a whole-phrase definition rather than a subject; 'back' and 'holding' are the two indicators.
explanation.definitionFit: A traducer is one who slanders or maligns others, which is to denounce them falsely.

clue.text: Just one month in the year the French king could raise this tax

parts.words: Just one month in the year
parts.note: Oct. is the abbreviation for October, one of the twelve months
roi is French for king

explanation.surface: A monarch of France was allowed to levy a particular duty during only a single month annually.
explanation.walkthrough: An octroi was a duty levied on goods entering a French town, which suits the French setting of the surface.
explanation.definitionFit: An octroi was a local duty charged on goods brought into a town, especially in France.

clue.text: Used to drive a car

parts.note: read as a description of what fuels a car, rather than of a person who once drove

explanation.definitionFit: Petrol is the British name for gasoline, the fuel burnt in a car engine to make it go.

clue.text: Preparation of staple dishes

indicators.note: preparation suggests the letters of the next word are made up into something new

explanation.surface: Making ready a basic foodstuff for the table.
explanation.definitionFit: Plates are flat dishes from which food is eaten.

clue.text: A fortifying drink or two — right?

parts.note: a brace is a pair, as of game birds

explanation.surface: Someone offers one or two restorative drinks and asks whether that is correct.
explanation.definitionFit: A bracer is a stiff drink taken to steady or strengthen oneself, a pick-me-up.

clue.text: Hemp's used in this kind of jacket

definitions.meaning: a hand-rolled cannabis cigarette is filled with hemp, the drug plant
a short, thick double-breasted coat worn by sailors

explanation.surface: Cannabis fibre goes into the making of a certain style of coat.
explanation.walkthrough: The surface suggests hemp as a fabric, but its sense here is the drug.
explanation.definitionFit: The word names both a cannabis cigarette and a sailor's thick double-breasted jacket.

clue.text: Pusillanimous attendants offering information

parts.note: pusillanimous means cowardly, and yellow is slang for cowardly
pages are young attendants on a knight or at a wedding

explanation.surface: Timid servants hand over some facts.
explanation.walkthrough: The definition is loose: the classified telephone directory is a source of information about local businesses.
explanation.definitionFit: The classified business directory is a reference source of trade information, printed on coloured paper.

clue.text: Newest trainee must be given a checkup

parts.note: L stands for learner, as on a learner driver's plate
a test is an examination or check-up

explanation.surface: A new recruit has to undergo a medical examination.
explanation.walkthrough: L plates mark learner drivers in Britain, so L is a common crossword trainee.
explanation.definitionFit: Latest means most recent, the newest available.

clue.text: Object about wrongdoers being supported

parts.note: an end is an object or aim, as in 'to that end'

indicators.note: about signals the letters are turned around and rearranged

parts.note: the doers part of the word is the anagram fodder

explanation.surface: Someone objects to criminals being given backing.
explanation.walkthrough: The anagram can use only the DOERS part of 'wrongdoers' (rearranged by 'about' to ORSED), so the clue is loose here; probably 'wrong doers' was meant.
explanation.definitionFit: To be endorsed is to be backed or approved publicly, that is supported.

clue.text: To resign from choice demands courage

indicators.note: from shows the letters are taken out of the words that follow

explanation.surface: Stepping down from a coveted position takes bravery.
explanation.walkthrough: 'courage' only completes the surface; the letters sit across choICE DEmands.
explanation.definitionFit: To cede is to give up or surrender, as one gives up a post on resigning it.

clue.text: A useful tool, though that cuts no ice!

definitions.text: A useful tool, though that cuts no ice!

parts.words: A useful tool, though that cuts no ice!
parts.note: plays on the idiom for having no effect, read literally: a tool whose name says it is chilly yet it is not for ice

explanation.definitionFit: A cold chisel is a steel chisel for cutting metal, so called because it works the metal unheated.

clue.text: Mother, by law breaking, is culpable

indicators.note: breaking signals that the preceding words are smashed and rebuilt

explanation.surface: A mother is guilty of breaking the law.
explanation.definitionFit: Blameworthy means deserving blame, which is what culpable means.

clue.text: Skilled worker giving men a chic new look

indicators.note: a new look for the words means their letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: A stylist gives the men a fashionable makeover.
explanation.definitionFit: A mechanic is a skilled manual worker, especially one who repairs machines.

clue.text: Lacking capital as a result of being axed

definitions.text: Lacking capital as a result of being axed

parts.words: Lacking capital as a result of being axed
parts.note: capital means head here, not money, so the reading is of someone beheaded

explanation.definitionFit: Someone beheaded by the axe is left without a head, capital being Latin-derived for head.

clue.text: Artisan alters creation

indicators.note: a creation from the letters means they are fashioned into a new word

explanation.surface: A craftsman modifies something he has made.
explanation.definitionFit: A slater is a craftsman who lays slates on roofs.

clue.text: Continue to run a place in the Northwest

parts.note: to bolt is to run off
on means onward, as in 'carry on' or 'go on'

explanation.surface: An order to keep running to a destination in the northwest.
explanation.walkthrough: BOLTON is a town in Greater Manchester, in north-west England.
explanation.definitionFit: Bolton is a large town near Manchester in North West England.

clue.text: Music composed by undistinguished church worker

parts.note: plain means ordinary, undistinguished
the worker ant is a crossword staple for worker

explanation.surface: Some music was written by a mediocre church employee.
explanation.definitionFit: Plainchant is unaccompanied liturgical singing in unison, a form of church music.

clue.text: A dry area in the main

definitions.text: A dry area in the main

parts.words: A dry area in the main
parts.note: the main is an old poetic word for the open sea, so this is dry land in the sea, not the chief area

explanation.definitionFit: An island is a piece of land surrounded by sea, a dry patch amid the ocean.

clue.text: A European land bird

definitions.meaning: a country straddling south-east Europe and Asia
a large domesticated fowl eaten at festive meals

explanation.definitionFit: The word names both the country spanning Europe and Asia and the large farmyard fowl.

clue.text: Without entitlement right now

definitions.meaning: without a title, i.e. nameless, as abbreviated for anonymous
an old word meaning at once, straight away

explanation.definitionFit: The word is short for anonymous (lacking a name or title) and is also an archaic term for immediately.

clue.text: Let's get back late, just like the stars!

indicators.note: get back tells us to read the word before it in reverse

parts.note: taken as written

explanation.surface: A suggestion to return home late, like the stars who only come out at night.
explanation.definitionFit: Stellate means star-shaped, radiating like a star.

clue.text: About fifty scoffed, but set forth

parts.note: re means about or concerning
L is the Roman numeral for fifty
to scoff is to eat greedily, so scoffed is ate

explanation.surface: Around fifty people ate, but then left.
explanation.walkthrough: Scoff is British slang for eating greedily.
explanation.definitionFit: To relate is to recount or narrate, to set forth a story.

clue.text: Offensive directed by plain-clothes policemen

parts.note: to run something is to direct it, so ran is directed
CID is the Criminal Investigation Department, the British police detectives who work out of uniform

explanation.surface: An attack led by undercover detectives.
explanation.definitionFit: Rancid describes something rank or foul-smelling, so offensive to the senses.

clue.text: Partially undressed for exercise

definitions.meaning: a set task or piece of schoolwork

explanation.surface: Stripping down part-way to do some exercise.
explanation.definitionFit: A school exercise or piece of instruction is a lesson; split, it reads as having less on.
